samples.description: AbxrLib's built-in sign-in UI: world-space keyboard, PIN pad, exit poll, debug window, and QR-code scanning. Import this to have AbxrLib draw its own authentication UI. Not needed if your app collects user input itself through Abxr.OnInputRequested. Dependencies: • TextMeshPro (part of com.unity.ugui on Unity 2023.2 and newer)
Example scripts for custom world-space buttons, hand-tracking interaction, and driving the keyboard yourself. Requires the World-Space UI sample.
